predicate: No visible prohibited asset means fund complies
novelty_or_rejection: Confidential portfolio blocks and coverage gaps defeat absence.
next_check_or_stop: No zero-filling hidden positions; below-limit lower bound is inconclusive.

predicate: Sum asset market values versus reported net assets
novelty_or_rejection: Financial-account consistency specialization; assets and net assets differ by liabilities and valuation.
next_check_or_stop: Do not count a naive sum mismatch or assume duplicated confidential aggregates are individual positions.

predicate: Long asset maturity versus short redemption promise
novelty_or_rejection: Maturity does not prove illiquidity; secondary-market and financing conditions matter.
next_check_or_stop: Requires redemption terms, liquidity stress model, liabilities and available facilities; not cheap from maturity alone.

next_check_or_stop: Need exact fund promise, asset/issuer mapping, permitted categories and relevant date; no automatic misconduct.
